verdict.rationale: Marketing copy explicitly claims natural-language audience description that mParticle translates into segment logic grounded in customer data ('Describe the audience... mParticle understands the customer data behind it, suggests the logic to use'), aligning with the story. However, this is only a homepage tagline, not detailed product documentation showing the review workflow, and there's no independent or hands-on corroboration of how well it works. Missing for 10: dedicated technical docs on the AI audience-builder, evidence of a human-review step before segment activation, and independent/hands-on validation of accuracy against real schema.
